title: Typography · Readability of informational text
slide_intent: Teach communicators to evaluate a page by how easily someone can scan and read it. Type size, line length and background compete for the reader’s attention.
strategic_value: A common reading standard can make guides, reports and newsletters easier to navigate for more people.
demonstration: A lead paragraph frames the reading task. Three columns organize decisions about layout, type size and face, and contrast against the background.
practical_value: Review the column width and paragraph length together with type size. Keep text left aligned and place informational copy on a quiet, high-contrast field.

content_islands.name: Reader reminder
content_islands.spec: Place the reader-centered note at left and a short purpose statement above the main columns.

content_islands.name: Layout and size
content_islands.spec: Set compact paragraphs under separate Layout and Font Size and Type headings. Relate size choices to column width.

content_islands.name: Contrast guidance
content_islands.spec: Use a third column for color and background guidance, including text over imagery.
